_doc: Every generated artifact in this repo, and the parity checker that proves it equals a fresh compile of its declared source. `generated-artifact-parity` reads this file. An artifact that carries the GENERATED banner but is not listed here is an error: an artifact nothing can re-derive is one that can be hand-patched while every other rule still passes, which is exactly what plan §2.3 says makes the other four rules durable.

artifacts.note: The JSON Schema half is emitted upstream by omnibase_core's scripts/emit_ts_types.py and needs a Python toolchain, so a full regenerate-and-diff cannot run in this repo's CI. What CI enforces is the half that rots: the checked-in schema is the one PROVENANCE.md records, and the emitted TypeScript carries the same symbols.
